verdict.rationale: BILL's v3 API covers Spend & Expense and says it can "manage transactions & reimbursements" (docs-2, docs-69), which gives an agent a first-party programmatic path to S&E transaction data. The only MCP server is for API documentation (docs-18), not live expense data. The in-product AI categorization (docs-9) is BILL's own feature, not an agent-facing coding API. missing for 10: documented retrieval of uncoded/uncategorized transactions, API write-back of category/GL coding to transactions, programmatic policy-flag submission, a review/approval handoff for agent-proposed coding, a data-access MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
